UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and synced app preferences stored per user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Optional user display name from Google Sign-In.

email.description: Optional user email address from Google Sign-In (owner-only PII).

createdAt.description: Immutable creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

WorkoutSession.title: WorkoutSession
WorkoutSession.description: Single recorded or synced workout session belonging to an authenticated user.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching the parent userId path segment.

externalId.description: Optional external provider record ID (e.g., Health Connect or Strava) for deduplication.

sportType.description: Type of physical activity or active rest.

source.description: Origin of the workout session record.

startedAtIso.description: ISO-8601 timestamp indicating when the workout started.

durationMin.description: Duration of the workout session in minutes (1..1440).

avgHr.description: Optional average heart rate in BPM (30..240).

rpe.description: Rate of Perceived Exertion on a 1..10 scale.

notes.description: Optional user notes or summary for the workout session.

dumbbellItems.description: Bounded list (max 30) of dumbbell or bodyweight exercise items performed.

createdAt.description: Immutable creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile document storing synced theme preference and account metadata.

/users/{userId}/workouts/{workoutId}.description: User-scoped subcollection of synced workout sessions.
